liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Reviewer hears the Terrapin, Playin' and China Doll sequence as exceptionally dark and heavy; The Terrapin into jam segment is singled out as truly amazing and powerful [15][22]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song jam is described as reaching a dreamy, otherworldly space [17]
- **Deal** (1 review): Deal closing the first set was especially strong, in the reviewer's view [18]
- **China Doll** (1 review): Reviewer calls this China Doll, following Terrapin and Playin', the best version they have heard [16]
- **Space** (1 review): During Space, Garcia plays phrases reminiscent of J.S. Bach [20]

## The recordings

- **gd84-10-28.sbd.ladner.21935.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 138 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sound is excellent apart from a few audience patches; Soundboard and front-of-board sources both sound good; the switch between them is barely noticeable, with no jarring cuts [16][22]
- **gd84-10-28.senn.vernon.17358.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 139 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is judged top quality sound throughout; Audience copy sounds nice; reviewer rates sound between 3.5 and 4; Described as a very good audience recording [17][18][21]
- **gd1984-10-28.179386.unknown.shotguns.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 140 min [3]
- **gd1984-10-28.175943.marantz.superscope.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 141 min [5]
- **gd1984-10-28.168286.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 137 min [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer prefers the 10/31 and 11/02 shows to this one [18]
- Reviewer considers this the best show of the middle part of the run [21]
- Reviewer attended all six run shows; this was a favorite, second only to 11/2, and underrated [24]
- Reviewer, who attended every show, prefers this 1984 Berkeley run to the following two years' runs there [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd84-10-28.sbd.ladner.21935.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>MC>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN - entire first set except for aud splice during LLR. First three tracks of second set are SBD with the remainder from an unlineaged FOB… [1]
- **gd84-10-28.senn.vernon.17358.sbeok.shnf**: source: Senn 441Âs>Sony D-5. Lineage: AUD>MC>DAT>CDR. Encoding by Willy Munder and Matt Vernon [2]
- **gd1984-10-28.179386.unknown.shotguns.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; Unknown shotgun mics > Sony TC-D5M [3]. Also: A Sennheiser 441 source from Jim Vita fills the first 21 seconds of Looks Like Rain and a patch in Drums into Space [3]
- **gd1984-10-28.175943.marantz.superscope.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Terry; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Terry's Master Audience Cassettes; Marantz Superscope EC-9P mics > Sony WM-D6C (Maxell XLII-S90) [5]. Also: An audience source patches 55 seconds of Looks Like Rain and 19 seconds of the Drums into Space transition [5]
- **gd1984-10-28.168286.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > ?? > Jim Vita's cassettes (Maxell XLII-S) [7]. Also: Audience patches supply opening notes of Cold Rain and Snow, the start of Terrapin Station, some crowd, and 49 seconds of Drums [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-10-30 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-10-30-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [27]
